import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Data from death_decomposition_preliminary.csv
tasks = [
    ("chemistry-mix", 20, 0.45, 0.25, 21.8),
    ("find-animal", 20, 0.50, 0.25, 26.65),
    ("find-non-living-thing", 40, 0.0, 0.0, 9.58),
    ("freeze", 20, 0.55, 0.25, 30.5),
    ("grow-fruit", 20, 0.45, 0.20, 25.1),
    ("identify-life-stages-1", 20, 0.55, 0.10, 47.5),
    ("identify-life-stages-2", 20, 0.50, 0.20, 30.0),
    ("inclined-plane-determine-angle", 20, 0.55, 0.20, 36.0),
    ("lifespan-longest-lived", 25, 0.56, 0.16, 44.0),
    ("lifespan-longest-lived-then-shortest-lived", 20, 0.45, 0.10, 40.8),
    ("measure-melting-point-unknown-substance", 20, 0.55, 0.25, 30.05),
]

names = [t[0] for t in tasks]
death_diff = [t[2] - t[3] for t in tasks]
delta_full = [t[4] for t in tasks]

# Regression
slope, intercept, r, p, se = stats.linregress(death_diff, delta_full)
print(f"r={r:.4f}, p={p:.2e}, slope={slope:.2f}, intercept={intercept:.2f}")

# Figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4))

ax.scatter(death_diff, delta_full, s=60, c='#2563eb', edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# Regression line
x_line = np.linspace(-0.02, max(death_diff) + 0.02, 100)
y_line = slope * x_line + intercept
ax.plot(x_line, y_line, '--', color='#dc2626', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.8, zorder=2)

# Annotate outlier (find-non-living-thing)
outlier_idx = names.index("find-non-living-thing")
ax.annotate(
    "find-non-living-thing",
    (death_diff[outlier_idx], delta_full[outlier_idx]),
    textcoords="offset points",
    xytext=(12, -8),
    fontsize=7,
    fontstyle='italic',
    color='#666666',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=0.8),
)

# Stats annotation
ax.text(
    0.05, 0.95,
    f"$r = {r:.4f}$\n$p = {p:.2e}$",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=8,
    verticalalignment='top',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#cccccc', alpha=0.9),
)

ax.set_xlabel("Death Rate Differential (Internal − Deterministic)", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("$\\Delta_{\\mathrm{full}}$ (Score Improvement)", fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Per-Task Death Rate Differential vs. Score Gain", fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-0.03, max(death_diff) + 0.05)
ax.set_ylim(0, max(delta_full) + 5)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
out = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_12/projects/simgate-modular-routing/docs/paper/figures/fig1_daf_scatter.pdf"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print(f"Saved to {out}")

import os
print(f"Size: {os.path.getsize(out)} bytes")
